title: MI5 warns UK universities to sever ties with Chinese research institute over espionage concerns
summary: Britain's domestic intelligence service alerts universities that a Chinese research institute is operating as a front for espionage targeting AI and defense sectors.
takeaways: MI5 identified CGTRI as front for Chinese ministry of state security (MSS)
CGTRI funded 100+ academics at multiple UK universities for research access
Target research: AI, cybersecurity, covert communications, steganography
Continued collaboration risks prosecution under National Security Act 2023

title: MIT Develops Stable RNA Vaccine Formulation for Room-Temperature Storage
summary: MIT researchers developed an RNA vaccine formulation enabling room-temperature storage for up to one year or ~100°F for two months, addressing the cold-chain limitation that has hindered mRNA vaccine distribution. An AI algorithm optimized the lipid nanoparticle design and polymer matrix.
takeaways: Stable at room temperature for up to 1 year; stable at ~100°F for 2 months
Mouse studies showed immune response as strong as Moderna-like cold-storage vaccines
Eliminates ultracold storage requirement (-90° to -15°C), reducing distribution costs
AI algorithm reduced number of experiments needed, accelerating development
14.3 million children received no vaccines in 2024 partly due to cold-chain logistics complexity

title: YODAS v3: World's Largest Open Speech Dataset with 1.1 Million Hours Across 147 Languages
summary: YODAS v3, released under Creative Commons BY 3.0 license, is a multilingual speech corpus containing over 1.1 million hours of high-fidelity 48kHz stereo audio spanning 147 languages. It is described as the largest open speech dataset to date and includes baseline models for speech recognition and n
takeaways: 1.1 million hours of audio across 147 languages
First large-scale speech corpus with high-fidelity stereo audio at 48kHz
Released under CC BY 3.0 open license
22 languages with 10,000+ hours; 73 languages with 5,000+ hours
Accepted to Interspeech 2026

title: DeepMind introduces SynthID Bio for watermarking AI-generated proteins
summary: DeepMind introduced SynthID Bio, a proof-of-concept method for embedding watermarks into AI-generated protein sequences while preserving their biological function. The technology enables authentication and tracking of synthetic proteins in downstream applications.
takeaways: SynthID Bio embeds identifying info into protein sequences
Watermarks preserve biological function of AI-designed proteins
Enables tracking and authentication of synthetic proteins
Addresses synthetic biology application needs

title: UK accuses China of using academics for espionage on AI and tech research
summary: The UK government accused China of leveraging academic channels to conduct espionage targeting artificial intelligence and technology research.

title: MIT Transit Lab develops AI platform for public transit with $2.1M Google.org grant
summary: MIT's Transit Lab received $2.1 million in funding from Google.org to build an open-source Public Transit Intelligence Hub for monitoring, operations, and passenger communication.

title: Game-playing AI defeats top Stratego champions with improved efficiency
summary: A new AI system achieved championship-level performance in Stratego, defeating top-ranked human players more efficiently than previous models, with potential applications in military strategy and business negotiations.

title: Google Launches Gemini 4 Argon, Next Frontier AI Model
summary: Google introduced Gemini 4 Argon as its next-generation frontier intelligence model.

title: ScopeBench: Measuring AI Agent Adherence to Engagement Boundaries Under Pressure
summary: Researchers introduce ScopeBench, a benchmark for evaluating whether AI agents maintain proper security boundaries when operating autonomously in web and network penetration testing environments.

title: AuthGuard-R: Defense Against Mission Hijacking in LLM-Controlled Robots
summary: Researchers present AuthGuard-R, a dual-gate defense system protecting LLM-controlled robots from malicious hijacking via text, speech, and visual instructions.

title: Production LLM-as-Judge in Text-to-SQL Fails to Align with Human Annotators
summary: Researchers found that a deployed GPT-4o-mini judge in a production text-to-SQL pipeline achieved only 0.04 Cohen's kappa agreement with human gold-standard annotations.

title: Spotify's Conversational Recommendation Agent: Synthetic Data and Self-Improvement
summary: Spotify describes bootstrapping conversational recommendation agents through synthetic data generation and self-improvement loops for natural-language content discovery.

title: Simultaneous Speech-to-Speech Translation with Causality-Aware LLM Framework
summary: A causality-aware framework extends LLMs to simultaneous speech-to-speech translation by addressing causally aligned training data scarcity.

title: Automatic Taxonomy Induction for Medical Answer Factuality Verification Failures
summary: Research identifies failure modes in retrieval-based factuality evaluation for LLM-generated medical claims through automatic taxonomy induction.

title: Recursive Self-Improvement via On-Policy Distillation for Reasoning
summary: On-policy distillation trains student models by generating trajectories and matching token predictions with teacher guidance, enabling self-improvement in reasoning tasks.

title: G²PTQ: Generalized Gradient Compensation for LLM Post-Training Quantization
summary: G²PTQ improves upon GPTQ-based post-training quantization methods using generalized gradient compensation, reducing memory and compute footprint without retraining.

title: NSF Invests $90 Million in Three New Science and Technology Research Centers
summary: The National Science Foundation launched three new Science and Technology Centers with a combined $90 million investment in transformative research.

title: Broward businessman convicted of smuggling nuclear research technology to Moscow
summary: A businessman from Broward County has been convicted of illegally smuggling nuclear research technology to Moscow.

title: Chain-of-Thought Prefix Scoring Corrupts Vision-Language Model Evaluation
summary: Prepending reasoning instructions before evaluating multiple-choice answers in vision-language models distorts scores by allowing models to peek at answer logits.

title: LLM Graders Fail Inconsistently on Long-Form Computer Science Exams
summary: Testing LLM graders on 570 dual-graded computer vision exams under 171 configurations reveals systematic failures where human graders would succeed.

title: Rufus-Air: Open Post-Training Recipe for GLM-4.5-Air-Base Large Language Model
summary: A detailed, reproducible post-training pipeline combines supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and agent training for a 106B parameter model.

title: Clinical Intent Extraction: FHIR-Aligned Benchmark for Future Patient Actions
summary: A new benchmark and representation standard enable extraction of prospective clinical actions (follow-ups, orders, referrals) from clinical notes.

title: PROOF: Profile-Oriented Factuality Benchmark for Fine-Grained LLM Reliability
summary: A new benchmark profiles where LLMs succeed and fail at factual recall, replacing aggregate scores with per-relation and per-perturbation reliability data.

title: FARE: Forensic Detection of Fraudulent AI Image Generators
summary: Researchers present FARE, a method for detecting when AI image generator providers switch models after passing governance certification, closing a gap in verification of deployed AI services.

title: Virginia Tech Receives $20 Million Grant for Cloud-Based Semiconductor Laboratory
summary: Virginia Tech secured a $20 million research grant to develop a cloud-based semiconductor laboratory.

title: Test-Time Augmentation Improves Calibration of Black-Box Radiology AI
summary: Test-time augmentation techniques enhance the calibration of clinical radiology AI systems without requiring model retraining.

title: Error and Prediction-Driven Motor Learning in the Cortico-Cerebellar Loop
summary: Research reveals how the brain combines forward prediction and error-driven learning to achieve robust motor control despite sensory delays.

title: Chance-Constrained Fine-Tuning Preserves LLM Safety
summary: A method for fine-tuning large language models on new objectives while maintaining safety performance on adversarial prompts.

title: Canopy: Multi-Fidelity Bandits for LLM Tree-Structured Optimization
summary: A bandit algorithm optimizes tree-structured LLM inference problems like model routing and test-time search using piecewise smooth priors.

title: Formal Verification of Graph Neural Networks for Power Systems
summary: Reachability-based methods formally verify graph neural networks with node and edge features used in power flow and cascading failure analysis.

title: Reward Hacking Poses Oversight Challenge for Autonomous Research Agents
summary: Autonomous research agents that design experiments and write reports create a reward-hacking risk by controlling both results and supporting evidence.

title: Sparse 'Grandmother Neurons' for Grammar Are Rare in Large Language Models
summary: Interpretability research finds that LLMs do not rely on sparse, dedicated neurons for encoding grammatical structure as classical neuroscience might predict.

title: LLMs Enable Automated Extraction of Policy Information from Government Documents
summary: Large language models can efficiently convert dense policy documents into structured survey responses for systematic policy monitoring.

title: Likelihood Ranking Fails to Scale Like Prompting for LLM Multiple-Choice Evaluation
summary: Probability-based scoring of multiple-choice answers does not improve with scale the way prompting-based scoring does.

title: Study examines effectiveness-fluency trade-offs in LLM conditioning
summary: Researchers systematically study the trade-offs between controlling LLM output effectiveness and maintaining natural language fluency.

title: Georgia Tech explores new pedagogical approaches integrating AI into learning
summary: Georgia Tech faculty investigate methods for incorporating AI tools into educational frameworks and student learning outcomes.

title: Diffusion Controller unifies and simplifies AI image generation workflows
summary: A new algorithm provides a unified framework for controlling diffusion-based image generation models.

title: Semiconductor Equipment Stocks Decline Amid Market Pressure
summary: Shares of Lam Research, Marvell Technology, Western Digital, FormFactor, and Penguin Solutions fell due to sector headwinds.

title: Oil-bubble research unlocks applications in environmental and medical technology
summary: Research into oil bubble dynamics could yield technological breakthroughs with applications across environmental remediation and medical fields.

title: McKinsey Technology Trends Outlook 2026
summary: McKinsey released its annual forecast of major technology trends expected to shape business and industry in 2026.

title: Autonomous ML engineering agents balance autonomy and safety guardrails
summary: Recent autonomous machine learning engineering agents advance on public benchmarks by operating on top of increasingly sophisticated safety mechanisms and constraints.

title: RLTL;DR: Agents improve through self-generated reinforcement learning feedback
summary: A reinforcement learning approach enables agents to improve on difficult, low-success-rate tasks by internalizing their own self-generated feedback.

title: Info-Tech Research Group identifies six leading AI code generation solutions in 2026 assessment
summary: Six AI code generation platforms are named champions in an emotional footprint and capability assessment by Info-Tech Research Group.

title: Task-aware spectral pruning for efficient LLM inference
summary: TASP enables dynamic sparse structures for different LLM tasks by applying task-aware pruning instead of static model compression.

title: The impossible trinity of time-series validation trade-offs
summary: Researchers establish a conservation law showing fundamental trade-offs between training sufficiency, test coverage, and temporal causality in time-series validation.

title: Zero-trust frameworks for LLM-powered data engineering and analytics
summary: Framework for securing LLM-agent coordination across code, data, infrastructure, and runtime in cloud data workflows.

title: WeatherDiagFlow: Evidence-grounded radar nowcasting with diagnostic flow refinement
summary: Radar nowcasting system that combines generative predictions with diagnostic evidence to support operational decision-making and verification.

title: Lam Research Opens 470,000-Square-Foot Warehouse in Livermore to Support AI Semiconductor Demand
summary: Lam Research, a semiconductor equipment manufacturer, has opened a new 470,000-square-foot facility in Livermore, California, its largest U.S. warehouse, expected to employ over 240 workers by 2027 to meet rising demand for AI and semiconductor technology.
takeaways: 470,000-square-foot facility at 710 Atlantis Street in Livermore
Expected to employ more than 240 workers by 2027
Largest warehouse in the U.S. for Fremont-based Lam Research
Designed to support growing semiconductor demand driven by AI and next-generation technologies

title: Georgia Tech and Pacific Northwest National Laboratory Expand Strategic Partnership
summary: Georgia Tech and PNNL have expanded their existing strategic research partnership.

title: Lawmakers Consider Disaster Technology Amid Federal Weather Research Funding Cuts
summary: Congressional lawmakers are evaluating disaster-related technologies as federal weather research funding faces cuts.

title: Vena and Acterys recognized as leaders in EPM software quadrant report
summary: Vena and Acterys have been designated as leaders in Info-Tech Research Group's 2026 Enterprise Performance Management software evaluation.

title: Tech Company Purchases Former IBM Campus in San Jose Hills
summary: An unspecified technology company has completed a deal to acquire a former IBM campus located in the San Jose hills.
